title: Mixed Event — Let's Study Hard!

meta.Outline: The end of the year is approaching at Kamiyama High School. An is headed to practice as usual when a teacher stops her and Mizuki in their tracks. That's when the pair are confronted with some hair-raising news about their prospects for the next school year.

rows.Line: After school
Kamiyama High School - Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
All done for the day!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I better get ready to leave so I don't keep Kohane waiting!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Hahaha! An, you always get so happy the second school is out.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: You're right. It's like the joy of freedom from the classroom floods her whole being.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What do you mean? It's a totally normal reaction, thank you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, don't you guys have club to get to? The second years won't be happy if you keep dawdling.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh my gosh, you're right! See you tomorrow, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: See you! Good luck with club!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Now then...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It's time for me to get going. What was it again that we're practicing today?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hiya, An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whoa! Mizuki?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: C'mon, don't jump out at me like that. What's up?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hehehe. Do you wanna walk home together today? Someone I know told me about this place with amazing apple pies!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: They're supposed to have amazing texture! Soft on the inside and crispy on the outside! Plus, the filling is really sweet, and they're not stingy with it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow, that does sound good...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But, sorry! I have singing practice with the others today.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, really? Oh well then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sorry. But thank you for inviting me.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No, you're fine. Let's hang out another—

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Shiraishi. Akiyama. May I have a word?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes? What's the matter?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: There's something we need to discuss. Follow me.
Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Here should be fine.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Um, so what is it you need to “discuss”?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Since you took us all the way here...
I'm guessing it's something you don't want the whole world hearing?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Well, yes...
Shiraishi. Do you remember how you did on the tests we had the other day?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I, um... Well...
I don't think my grades were high, exactly...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: B-But, I'm sure they weren't all low! Like, home ec...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Home ec...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh yeah! And I didn't fail math either!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: It's true that you achieved good results for math this time. However... What about classics and chemistry?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Um, well... The thing is...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: A-Anyway! Was there a problem with my test results?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Shiraishi... You are a high schooler now.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: You need to show that you have the academic ability of one to advance to second year.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?! Y-You don't mean—

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Starting Monday, you'll be going to supplementary classes for a week.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
S-S-Su...
Supplementary classes?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: B-But, no! You've gotta be kidding!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, supplementary classes...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I am not kidding! This is no laughing matter.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Rules are rules.
If you don't score high enough on tests, we have to fail you.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: That said, we teachers don't want any of you to be held back. We'll be giving you supplementary classes specifically in order to prevent that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Groan*

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Now that we're clear on that...
I expect you to show up every day on time, starting on Monday.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ahaha... That sure sucks, An.
But, it'll be worth the hard work to make sure you go into second year.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: What's this Akiyama? It looks like the pot is calling the kettle black.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: You're taking those supplementary classes too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! Wh-Wh-Why?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But, my test scores were totally fine, weren't they?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Yes, I can't deny your academic achievement. The issue is your attendance.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No no no! I did a ton of worksheets the other day 'cause I was told it would make up for my low attendance!

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Yes, you did.
However, you had a string of absences after that.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That's true...
But, I made sure they were all days that it would be okay to skip and—

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(...? Hang on...
Didn't the teacher get sick one time, and math got swapped with English the next day...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Wait. If that's true, then...
My English attendance is—)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: It seems I've jogged your memory?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Uh... Umm... Well...
Yes...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Well then, have I made myself clear?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Shiraishi. Akiyama. I expect you both to attend all of next week's supplementary classes.

rows.Speaker: An & Mizuki
rows.Line: N-Nooo!
Street SEKAI
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: ...and, so...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, you guys!
I have to take supplementary classes all next week!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, An...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I really am sorry!
I've gotta stay back after school every day to study...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But, I promise I'll practice as soon as I get home!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
It can't be helped.
Being held back would be terrible...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Have you talked to your dad yet?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
He told me to knuckle down and study hard so I don't get held back...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then, there's nothing for me to say. If there's anything I can do to help, let me know.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Good luck, An!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I don't really know much about school...
But I'll do anything I can to support you!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
Me too, me too!
I'll make you lots of tasty coffee to keep you energized!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Good idea. I'll make lots of sweet snacks for you too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you! I'll do my best!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, I guess it's just going to be the three of you at practice until An finishes her supplementary classes.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: True. Akito, Azusawa, let's just do what we can for now.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Akito?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Huh? Come to think of it, Akito, you're oddly quiet today. Is something up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito. Don't tell me...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: ...too.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I...have supplementary classes too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Y-You too, Shinonome...?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, why didn't you say so?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I-I see... Akito and An, we're rooting for both of you!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It'd be a disaster if neither of you got to go into second year!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh... So Akito's taking supplementary classes too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Well, that checks out.
It'd be crazy if I had to take supplementary classes but not you...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh?! What's that supposed to mean? I'm smarter than you, and—

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What? No you're not.
I only failed two subjects.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: The same as me, then. And for the record, I scored higher than you in world history.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So what? In math, I—

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: B-Both of you, please calm down...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. Pointlessly arguing over such things changes nothing about the fact that you both failed.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: *Wince*

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: The important thing now is for you both to make the most of the supplementary classes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Point taken.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Toya's right...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (These classes are going to be tough, but...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I've gotta study hard and make sure I get into second year!)
A few days later
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Urgh, supplementary classes...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah... I don't know if I'll survive going to them for five days in a row...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And I can't believe you're joining us, Li'l Bro. You failed too, then?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Shut up... You're taking these classes too.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Unlike you two, I'm just here because of attendance.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ahaha... By the way, what are we actually going to do in the supplementary classes? I haven't heard anything.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Oh, I heard it's mostly time for self-study.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But on the last day, we've gotta take a test for the subjects we failed, and we'll get into second year if we pass that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: O-Oh... I guess we'll need to work hard.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah...
Hm? Is that...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Urgh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Tenma?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Akito? Shiraishi? And Akiyama!
You must all get on well to be traveling in a pack!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, that's not why... We're just headed the same way.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're headed to supplementary classes.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Supplementary classes? You too...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh? “You too”? You don't mean...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're taking supplementary classes too, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Y-Yes...
Unfortunately so...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow! Who knew I'd know so many people in the supplementary classes!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: By the way, how many tests did you not pass, Tsukasa?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh yeah, I'm curious to know too!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It was physics for me. It's never been my strong suit, so I did put effort into studying for it... But I was bested nonetheless...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, you were studying then?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Fruitlessly, it seems...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What about you three?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I failed English! My attendance was too low.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I see. And you two, Akito and Shiraishi?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh, yeah, about us...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Come on now! You don't want to hear about us. Let's just all work hard in the supplementary classes!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes, you're right. The classes won't be easy, but we can persevere if we encourage each other!
Several dozen minutes later
Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Alright, does everyone have their own worksheets?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: In that case, you may begin.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Whoa... I didn't realize just how many worksheets there were...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Anyway, I've gotta work through them!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (There's an answer sheet with explanations, so all I have to do is score myself using that...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And then keep doing that until I can get them right... Then repeat with the next worksheet...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Urgh... But I'll never get through all these sheets! This is worse than regular classes...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(This sucks, but getting held back would be worse...
Not to mention that I don't wanna cause any more trouble for Toya and everyone.)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I've just gotta do it...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Let's see...
“Read the following excerpt from the medieval anthology Tsurezuregusa and answer the questions below.”)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (“The chaunginge of...the sesoun...stirreth the...pathos of thinges in...alle manere...wyse.”)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (“And autumpne...stirreth it most of al, oft it...hath bin said...”)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Urgh... I don't understand any of this...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
(I really am hopeless with Classical Japanese... The words all look familiar, but I don't have a clue what they mean.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(I wonder how everyone else is doing...
Mizuki...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Mizuki's asleep?!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Well, I guess that makes sense...
There's no point in studying hard if you already have good test scores.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (What about Akito?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Yay... He's suffering as much as me...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Wait, no! We're all going into second year together! I have to do my best!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (“Fill in the conjugation table below for the underlined word.”)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(I have to try... I have to try...
But...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Urgh... What am I supposed to do? I don't understand any of this!)
After class

rows.Speaker: An & Akito
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa, you guys look terrible...
Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You're...chirpy.
Well, I guess you got a nap in...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Well, yeah. I took a flick through the worksheets at the start, but I knew it all already. I figured the test on Friday should be a breeze.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Groan*
That's nice. I wish I could say the same!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone.
It looks like your supplementary class is over.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Toya?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, did you... Did you come here just to check in on us?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, because your chances of entering second year are hanging in the balance.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: How was it, you two?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ahaha... It took a lot out of both of them.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I suspected as much...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Then it's decided.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm going to teach the two of you.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You are...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. At this rate, you two may actually be held back a year.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm definitely grateful...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But... Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I hate to say it, but don't you think teaching us by yourself is gonna be pretty tough?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah, you have a point. Between the two of you, he'd have to cover four subjects.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As you say, teaching you by myself will not be easy. That's why I brought help.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Help?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hello there.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: K-Kamishiro?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And Tenma...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Aoyagi here asked me to help the two of you study.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What?! You asked Kamishiro?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I did. He's the most talented student in his school year. Is there a problem?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: N-No... Not a problem...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But, why is Tenma here too?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Well, I was planning to get help with my studies from Rui as well.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But then Aoyagi also asked for my help.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If possible, I wanted to help all of you. So, Tsukasa and I discussed it, and—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Do you want to join us for study sessions after the remaining supplementary classes?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If we all gather in one place, I'll be able to help all three of you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That makes sense...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I seriously have to be taught by Kamishiro?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
(I don't feel great about it...
But Toya's right that he knows what he's doing when it comes to studying. In which case...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kamishiro, please help us!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We'd appreciate it.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Certainly. I'll do my best to be of help.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By the way, Mizuki. Would you like to join the study sessions?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh, me?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's right. There's strength in numbers, so we could use another teacher.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh yeah...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I agree with Rui. We'd be asking a lot of you, Mizuki, but please consider it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh? Hm... I don't know...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Please...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, what the heck.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm in! I'll teach you guys what I know!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really?! Thank you, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hey, Akito! You should be saying thank you too.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
You're right...
Thanks, Akiyama. You're doing us a solid.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ooh! A rare sighting of Li'l Bro's soft side.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. I think that alone made it worth agreeing.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Cut it out...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. Well then, let's all do our best with these study sessions.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!
Kamiyama High School - Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Well then, let's begin our study session.

rows.Speaker: Akito, An & Tsukasa
rows.Line: Thank you for doing this!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But, how are we actually gonna teach them?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There's a test on the final day of the supplementary classes, yes?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: The content of the classes must be targeted at that. Could I take a look at the worksheets you received in class?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sure, here you go.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thank you. Hmm...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see. It seems the bulk of the questions cover the fundamentals of each subject. While there's a lot here, there are no complicated tests of applied knowledge.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That may be intentional on the part of the teachers since the goal of the test is to prevent students from being held back.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, the physics questions I answered were mostly basic knowledge.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: So were mine. Although, I still flunked the test.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah, me too.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: What this means is that all you need to do is become able to solve all the problems in your worksheets.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
How about this, then?
We'll spend time focusing on the topics covered by the worksheets you each received.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You'll go back over each worksheet, while using the exercises in the textbook for particularly weak areas.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And if you encounter anything you don't understand, you can ask us three for help.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: O-Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, but will we definitely be able to help them out? What about you Toya? Do you have any weak subjects?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: As I recall, Shiraishi failed classics and chemistry, while Akito failed English and math.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'll have no trouble with basic questions for those four subjects. How about you, Akiyama?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yep, those subjects are no trouble for me!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Also, when we teachers have spare time, we should review upcoming topics and be ready to answer questions.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Understood.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Thank you all...!
I'm gonna try my best!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Great! Now, let's get this study session started!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Uh...
“The chaunginge of the sesoun...stirreth the pathos of thinges...in alle manere wyse...”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Urgh... Just like in class, I don't understand it at all.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It's just a non-starter every time since I don't even get the meaning of the sentence...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (For now, I'd better try reading on...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “And autumpne stirreth it most of al...oft it hath bin said...”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “Forsooth...it may be so...yit nought...can enflame the...herte...as can...”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(“Enflame”...
Like getting fired up? But what does “forsooth” mean...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Urgh... What the heck!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I really don't get this at all! Is this seriously something a Japanese person wrote?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I understand what you mean...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You can't just read that stuff intuitively.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hahaha...
The thing with Classical Japanese is that you won't get very far unless you build up your vocabulary first.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: An, which words do you not know?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uhh... Almost all of them?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
All of them...
Okay, let's break it down!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So the first line is...
“The chaunginge of the sesoun stirreth the pathos of thinges in alle manere wyse.” Is there anything there you want me to explain?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes! What's the “pathos of thinges”?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hmm... It's like a feeling you get when something is rich in charm. We'd say “pathos of things” in modern times.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
When something has charm...
That's a phrase I hear a lot, but come to think of it, I don't know exactly what it means.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
In other words, it's profoundly elegant.
However, that may be somewhat abstract as a definition.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It might be easier to look through the lens of your lived experience. For example...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shiraishi, have you ever been captivated by the sky at dusk?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The sky? At dusk...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh! Sometimes, at the end of a day of singing practice, I'll feel really tired, look at the sky and think it looks gorgeous!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I understand that too! When I look at the sky after pushing myself to the limit, it always looks so vast and peaceful.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes! I know exactly what you mean!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That deeply sentimental feeling is more or less what is called “the pathos of things”.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, I see...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And “sesoun” is an old way to say “season”...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
As for “alle manere wyse”...
It basically means “in all sorts of ways.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So that means...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: The changing seasons...lend a rich charm to everything?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yeah! You got it!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa! Thanks, you guys!
I finally get what it means.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
There you go, Shiraishi.
You're getting a knack for this.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, she can read one line, at least.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Thank you for the input, Akito.
Have you finished your own exercises? I haven't seen your pen move in a while.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: *Wince*

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha! Guess you're in the lead, An! Let's keep this up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Sorry, Rui! Help me!
I'm utterly lost!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Let's see... You'll arrive at the answer if you apply the formula. Do you remember it?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Um... I may have a recollection...
Sorry. Can you explain it from the basics?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Urgh... I don't even get what this says.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Sine? Cosine? Tangent?
Even if I learn what these words mean, they won't help me...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Relax, Akito.
First, look at the lengths of two sides of the triangle. From there, you can start working out the answers.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We'll work through them all, together.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Um, so... This word means...“wonderful” or “rare”...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And this one means “excellent”...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What the...
The word for “shameful” used to mean “impressive”?!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hahaha, you can do it!
The most important thing to do now is learn the most common words.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ngh... They're not sinking in at all...
A few hours later

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, look at the time.
I think you're all getting tired, so let's call it a day.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: It's finally over...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: My head hurts...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: That's proof of how hard you've been working. And, to absorb what you've learned today more effectively, you can review it before you go to bed tonight.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You gotta be kidding me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Urgh, I don't wanna think anymore...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But... I have to do this...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I will pass the test, and I will get into second year with the others!)
Main Street

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm wiped out!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know, right? I'm aching all over. Why do they have to make the chairs at school so hard?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Do you think so? They've never really bothered me, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! It can't be good for the body to sit like that for hours on end.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Personally, I don't understand how everyone can bear to be in a classroom for that long like it's normal.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I guess you don't come to school that often, do you Mizuki? And even when you do, you skip a whole bunch of classes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So I'm even more grateful that you came in to help us today. You made everything really clear, and I made some good progress!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Don't mention it!
It was more fun than I expected♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, more importantly, look over there! It's that apple pie place I told you about!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow. I can already smell them from here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It has great reviews online. But, whoa... The place is rammed inside.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: If it's that crowded, I'll go and buy them myself. You wait out here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure? Thanks, Mizuki!
Ten or so minutes later

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I wonder when Mizuki will be back...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh yeah. I can use spare moments like this for study. I should have time to do some vocabulary.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I studied so hard today that my head kinda hurts... But the others are putting in so much effort for our sakes that we have to pull our weight.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Um, where's that vocab list...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh, hi An!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh... What are you two doing here?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line:
We're headed home from club!
It was pretty intense today since the second-years made us run a ton...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Oh yeah, we heard about you taking supplementary classes. Apparently you might get held back a year?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, what?! How do you know that?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Through the grapevine. I knew your grades weren't the best, but...oof.

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: But, I heard that they do these classes every year to help people out. I bet it'll all be fine as long as you take it seriously.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Grimace*
I hope so.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I have some friends with good grades who are helping me study, so I guess it'll be alright...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line:
Oh, really?
I guess you won't be needing us then.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Earlier, we were all talking about helping you study if you needed it.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: We're not exactly straight A students ourselves, but how does the saying go? Strength in numbers?

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: A bunch of people said they'd pitch in, so we'd be unstoppable if we combined forces.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: Well, anyway. If there's anything we can do to help, let us know. We'll be there for you.

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Yeah, just like friends should!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Got it! Thanks, you two!

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: See you later, An!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Bye!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm kinda happy. Not just Mizuki and the others, but everyone is jumping to help me out...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Sorry, An! I got out as quick as I could. That place was so crowded.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
No problem at all!
I was just talking to my friends.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Your friends?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. Two of my classmates were passing by and said hello. They already know about the supplementary classes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It was kinda embarrassing...
But they let me know they've got my back, which made me feel better.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really...? That's great!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Come to think of it, you really have a lot of friends, An. I always see you talking with people in other classes and years.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Do you think so? I'd say I have an average amount of friends.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: No way! It's not even just students, you chat with the teachers and the custodian too. There's nothing average about getting on with so many different people so easily.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm the outgoing type myself, but you're on a different level.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hm... Maybe?
I never thought about it much...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, maybe it's because I've been singing on Vivid Street for years?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I grew up in a neighborhood where everyone loves music. And I've been singing there since I was little.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Whenever I did, all sorts of people would come and say hi, and I just naturally get to know them, I guess?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And, even if we got into fights, we'd always be closer by the end.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Really?
Wait, fights...?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Singing on the street can lead to arguments sometimes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Vivid Street attracts a lot of young, intense types, and over time you start to have a history with them.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wow...
It sounds like a pretty wild place...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha. To be clear, they're not bad people. Everyone's just really passionate about music. And even when we do butt heads, it usually gets resolved with singing battles.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And after battling the same person a few times, you start to understand the passion and pride behind their singing...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Even if they grated on you at first, you start to recognize that you share that commitment to singing.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, really?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really. So, I guess that's why I'm this way. I've learned to just be genuine and direct with everyone I meet. That way, sooner or later we'll get to know each other and accept all the different parts of each other.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And I think that's why I don't have any trouble socializing and getting to know people.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wow.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That's pretty cool. I had no idea you thought about it that way, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's not like I think about this stuff all the time. That's just what came to mind when I gave it some thought just now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If anything, I don't think about much at all usually.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha, is that so?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Still...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(An's amazing...
I can't imagine being so confident about getting close to people and accepting each other.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (That must be why, that time...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Phew... Finally lunch break.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Urgh, I don't wanna go to class in the afternoon... Maybe I'll ditch school once I eat...)
Hey! Akiyama, right?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Nice to meet you!
I'm An Shiraishi. You can call me An.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Uh... N-Nice to meet you.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, did I startle you? Sorry about that!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I just wanted to get to know you since we're classmates and all!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha. Well, you did spook me a little, but don't sweat it.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You can call me Mizuki! Nice to meet you, An.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (It was right after we started high school, and everyone was giving me a wide berth... But An just came and talked to me like normal.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (And she could do that because...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She believes it's possible to find common ground with everyone... And that's why she's friendly and direct with everyone she meets.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mizuki? Is something wrong?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh... Nope, I'm all good!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Wanna get going?
It's getting a little chilly out.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Sure!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: More importantly, the pies! They're gonna get cold after we waited so long for them!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Here, An, eat up!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! Here I go!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mmm! What the heck, this is so good!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Nothing beats sugar for a tired brain!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
You got that right!
Thanks for buying these, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You're welcome!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
That reminds me!
They had a whole bunch of other flavors, like maple syrup and cinnamon!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We should totally go back sometime and try them!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, let's do that!
When's good for you?
The next day - After school
Kamiyama High School - Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “And autumpne stirreth it most of al, oft it hath bin said.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Um, so...
Everyone says that things are most charming in fall...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: “Forsooth it may be so, yit nought can enflame the herte as can...”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: That may be true, but nothing is as moving as...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ooh, look at you, An!
You've come so far since yesterday.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I guess. Well...
I do have to check the textbook for vocabulary and conjugations, but I'm getting there.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I looked at my vocab list in the bath last night, but it was stressful since I couldn't really memorize much.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Really?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Well then!
I have an exciting present for such a hardworking student!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Here you go!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It's...a notebook?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Yup! I made it last night. I put together a whole bunch of study notes like important words to learn and conjugation crib sheets.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wow... You went to all this trouble for me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
This is...impressive.
Your notes are very clear and concise.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
They are, aren't they?!
Feel free to keep praising me!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, you really took it seriously. What brought that on so suddenly?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Um, rude.
I just want An not to get held back a year.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: An, I'm rooting for you to make it into second year armed with this!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you, Mizuki! I'll make good use of it!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yes! I solved it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Good work, Akito.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Everyone, how about we stop for a while? Breaks are important for maintaining concentration.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! I've been getting thirsty, so I'll go grab a drink.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: How about rock paper scissors then? Loser buys for everyone.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Ooh, I like that! Let's do it!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
That's fine by me...
However, it will be a lot for one person, so how about the last two people go?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Here we go.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Rock...paper...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Scissors!
Ten or so minutes later

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I can't believe I lost...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Not to mention how they all asked for snacks and other food on top of drinks, so the bags are stuffed to the brim.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, I suppose they're just that tired. I could take your bag?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh, that's fine, Kamishiro!
You already took the heavier bag.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Actually, are you fine carrying that?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
It's no trouble.
I wouldn't want to tire you out since you need to save your energy for your studies.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha, you're exaggerating.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But... Thank you, really.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Not just for carrying the bag...
For teaching us, too. You explain things so clearly, and it's all so helpful.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: There's no need to thank me. I've been having fun myself with things being so lively.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? That's good to hear!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Also... Mizuki seems to be having fun.
I certainly wasn't expecting that notebook.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, I was surprised too!
That was such a thoughtful gesture.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And yesterday, when I said thank you for helping us with studying, Mizuki just said, “Don't mention it!” and “It was fun.”

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm glad.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, that reminds me... Didn't the two of you go to the same junior high school?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Were you close back then too?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'd say so... We'd meet up and chat from time to time.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mizuki seems to be having much more fun now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: These study sessions are proof of that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Really? I guess I only know the Mizuki we have right now.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. I think it comes down to having friends who are good influences.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: And I believe you're one such friend, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Me?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I think having friends like you is a big help for Mizuki.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Friends like me...?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... But I really haven't done anything.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I mean, I just enjoy spending time with Mizuki, so I wanted to be friends!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, I don't feel like I've done anything to help. Oh, but...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: If Mizuki is glad that we became friends, I couldn't be happier!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I see.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: We're back! And we bring drinks and snacks!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
About time, guys!
I'm starving here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Sorry!
But we got the French fries you asked for.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Ooh! At long last!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Got my cheesecake?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes sirree. Is this the right one?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, thanks.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Thanks for waiting, Tsukasa, Toya. Shiraishi has the food, and the drinks are in my bag.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Got it! Many thanks, Rui, Shiraishi!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Let's see, this coffee is yours, right Toya? It's hot, so be careful.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Thank you, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Here's your orange juice, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Be sure to eat plenty and get ready to study more.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!
The next day
Kamiyama High School - Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Kamishiro! Thank you so much for teaching me that mnemonic yesterday! I think I've memorized the elements!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Really?
Well then, why not test yourself by writing them out?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! Uhh... Huh?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh no. I remembered the mnemonic, but not what any of it means!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Akito, is that a probability problem you're working on?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Do you mind not snooping on my notebook?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Heh heh heh. I'm very au fait with that unit! I shall take this opportunity and teach you!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh, no one asked you to do that... I'm fine, really.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: No need to be polite! The trick to solving these is to...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: It's like talking to a brick wall... I guess I'll just let him teach me.
The day after that

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Rote memorization has its place in the classroom... However, you won't get far just glaring at your textbook.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's where this device comes in.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I saw that earlier... What is it?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. This right here is my instantaneous memorization device. It delivers intense stimulation to all the senses to help the user instantly commit knowledge to memory.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's still an experimental prototype, but I can guarantee your safety. Would you like to try it out, Shinonome?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Who the heck would try that weird thing out?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I... I'm kinda...curious...
Anything to get these weird chemical formulas to stay in my brain...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: C-Calm down, Shiraishi. Organic learning is the way forward...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Man, I'm beat!
Time for a little break.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... Excuse me.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh, Kusanagi?
What are you still doing at school?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Um... I heard from Rui and Tsukasa about your study sessions.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I brought these to keep you all going. They're chocolates from this shop by the station... Feel free to share them around if you like.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What?! Are you sure?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah. I could tell Tsukasa and Rui have been working hard, and they say eating chocolate helps when you're tired.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you! You're a lifesaver!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: No problem... Good luck with studying.
Last day of supplementary classes

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It looks like everyone's here.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. Today's the day...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is it. Everything hinges on whether you can pass this test.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Do you feel prepared?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Of course I do.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: How hard do you think I've been working for this? I'm not about to crumble at the last hurdle.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah... Yes, I feel the same.
Also...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I owe it to the three of you for all you've done to help us out.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm gonna give it all I've got.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha. I guess I need to treat this test seriously too. After all, I want to go into second year too.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Yes! Well then...
Let's all be sure to pass this test...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: ...and make it into the next year!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright...
We're going in!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Okay. Good luck, all of you.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Do you think they'll be alright?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I have every confidence.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You saw for yourself, Aoyagi, how much effort they put into studying each day.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: By this point, they can surpass any obstacle in their way. All you and I can do now...is have faith and be patient.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You're right.

rows.Speaker: PlaceInfo
rows.Line: Empty Classroom

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Does everyone have their test?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Some of you are being tested for more subjects than others, so please submit your tests to me when you finish.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I will grade you immediately and inform you of your results before you leave.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: I want you to show your best efforts and not let the past week go to waste.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: You may begin.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Yes! That's chemistry out of the way. And I hardly had trouble with any questions...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But now it's classics... I've gotta focus.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Okay, it's going well.
I understand everything so far...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (There are two sections... The first is Literary Chinese.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (This looks okay. I've never had that much trouble with this part of classics, so I can get the gist of it...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But the second one is Classical Japanese... My Everest...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Let's take a look at the passage...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Wait! This is...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (“The chaunginge of the sesoun stirreth the pathos of thinges in alle manere wyse.”)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (“And autumpne stirreth it most of al, oft it hath bin said. Forsooth it may be so, yit nought can enflame the herte as can the seytes of springe.”)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It's the essay I read on the first day of supplementary classes with everyone's help...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Okay. I can do this...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh! Sometimes, at the end of a day of singing practice, I'll feel really tired, look at the sky and think it looks gorgeous!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, I understand that too! When I look at the sky after pushing myself to the limit, it always looks so vast and peaceful.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yes! I know exactly what you mean!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe. That deeply sentimental feeling is more or less what is called “the pathos of things”.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Yeah...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (The changing seasons...lend a rich charm to everything.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Everyone says that things are most charming in fall, but nothing is as moving as...the sights of spring.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (When spring is announced by birdsong and gentle sunlight, and the sprouting of shoots and buds in hedges...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I can read it.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I can visualize what the words are saying...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (It doesn't sound like some weird magic words anymore. I understand the emotions behind the writing!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I can feel what the writer was feeling... What it's like to look at nature and feel sadness and beauty and a surge of emotion... The pathos of things...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I owe this to the others. Mizuki, Kamishiro, Toya... And to Akito and Tenma for studying alongside me, too.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (No, not just them. I have so many other friends who've been there for me.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Their support and kindness have kept me going...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I can do it now...! I can answer all these questions!)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (An's so focused...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I've gotta pull my weight too. Right?)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: (I owe it to them for believing in me. There's no way I'm going out there defeated...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Wait... It's over...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I guess I was really focused... It went by...so fast...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Wait, no. I should check my work...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Everything's fine...
I answered every question, and I didn't make any mistakes filling in the answer sheet.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Yeah... This should be...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
(Thanks, guys.
I got here thanks to you...)
Kamiyama High School

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Mizuki and Tsukasa should be out soon...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes... Though, Akito and Shiraishi have two subjects, so they'll be longer...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm so tired...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Wait, have you two been waiting for us?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Welcome back, Mizuki.
How did it go?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I passed with flying colors, of course!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Did you? That's good.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thanks! Tsukasa should be back soon too, don't you think?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes. I believe so...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Oh, have I kept you three waiting?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, how did it...
No, I don't need to ask.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Exactly! I passed, of course!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Congratulations, Tsukasa!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
So you'll still be in the year above me next year!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Uh, yes... Now that you mention it, it's frightening to think about what could have been. That was a close shave...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Once again... Thank you, Rui.
Thanks to you, I'll be able to go into third year.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hehe, there's no need to thank me. I want us to be third-years together.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So this just leaves Li'l Bro and An, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes. Come on you two, you can do it!
Several dozen minutes later

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito... Shiraishi...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hahaha... Don't fret about them.
I caught a glimpse of them when I left the classroom, and they were both concentrating super hard.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Really...? If you say so...
It's finally over...
I'm so tired...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, Shiraishi...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Sorry to keep you guys waiting.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: We don't mind... But, how did it go?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, I messed up some questions, but it was alright in the end.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It was?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Good job, Akito!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh... Sure. Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: And An? What about you?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I passed!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Not just that, look...!
I got a perfect score in classics!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Seriously?! That's amazing!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! The teacher told me I did a really good job!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Whoa, not bad.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: You earned this, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Congratulations, Shiraishi.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Thank you! All of you, from the bottom of my heart.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So everyone passed. Yay!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Though, apparently...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: We could've taken this test as many times as it took.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Wait, what do you mean?! We had more than one chance?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. This one guy failed, but the teacher just sent him back to his desk to try again.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Are you serious?!
So, we didn't actually need to study that hard for it?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, if we didn't study a little bit, we'd never get some questions right no matter how many times we tried.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Exactly. Also, I imagine the teacher purposefully kept quiet about that part.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: If students knew that they had unlimited attempts, at least some of them would slack off.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh... That makes sense.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But... I think I preferred it this way.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You did?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm... I was thinking during the test.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: About how nice it's been studying with you guys this past week.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Shiraishi...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: You guys worked so hard to teach me so much, and I became able to answer questions that I was clueless about at first...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I realized how much your support and kindness have kept me afloat.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: And I realized how glad that makes me feel!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Also... I was really pleased to be able to answer the questions. Especially since I can finally read Classical Japanese...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I even got to understand what the person writing it was feeling... It was kinda fun.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I usually don't like studying since it's so hard, but I realized that it's not all so bad.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I know what you mean.
When I finally solved those math problems that'd given me so much trouble, I had a real sense of accomplishment.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! I've also come to enjoy physics more than before!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I still don't exactly love studying...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But I'm really happy I did my best!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Shiraishi...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I have all of you to thank for this.
Not just you three for teaching us, but you two for studying so hard alongside me...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, thank you so much!
A few days later - Closing ceremony
Kamiyama High School - Gym

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: Ahem, a very good morning, students.

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: You've all made it to today's closing ceremony through consistent diligence. However, over the break you must remember to keep safe, and...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: *Yawn*

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hey, Mizuki!
Try and be a little more subtle!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: C'mon, don't the principal's speeches make you sleepy when they drag on like this?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I get what you mean, but still...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, don't you feel a little sentimental knowing that it's our last day as first-years?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hm... I guess I do?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
You don't at all, do you?

rows.Speaker: Principal
rows.Line: ...and so, as part of your ongoing intellectual and physical development, I'd now like you all to take this opportunity to cast your minds back on the past year's events.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (The past year...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I guess a lot did happen...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I was looking for a partner for so long. Someone to surpass RAD WEEKEND with...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I couldn't find anyone, but...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I found the best partner I could ask for. Someone who makes my heart race...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I met Miku and the others... I had some conflict with Toya and Akito at first, but then they became my amazing teammates.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Now I know about Nagi's dream for us.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (We're going to surpass RAD WEEKEND. I've never believed it so strongly.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And so... I'm going to keep moving forward with the others...!)
A few hours later
Class 1-A

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Phew, we're all done!
It's a nice bonus to finish school at lunchtime.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hahaha, I know what you mean.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But... I guess we'll never come back to this classroom again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right.
When you put it like that, it's a little sad.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But, put it this way!
That's only true because you escaped being held back a year!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: H-Hey! You don't need to bring that up.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hahaha! Still...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Thank you, An.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hmm?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: It was fun being your classmate!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We might be in different classes next year, so I figured I'd say it now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I had fun too! But you know...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Even if we aren't classmates next year, nothing's going to change. You'll still be my friend.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to being your friend in second year, Mizuki!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh... Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I'm looking forward to it too, An!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, by the way. Do you wanna get lunch after this?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know it's last minute, but I suggested to Rui and the others that we have a little after-party to celebrate getting through the supplementary classes.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I know you're super busy, but if you're gonna eat lunch anyway...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Oh... I'm not sure...
I'd love to join you, but I have practice...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Actually, no. I'll go with you.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, are you sure it's okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. I might leave partway through to go to practice, so as long as that's fine!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Woohoo!
That's totally fine♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We agreed to meet at the gate, so let's head there together when you're ready!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay!
School Gate

rows.Speaker: Classmate A
rows.Line: See you, An, Akiyama!

rows.Speaker: Classmate B
rows.Line: Don't be strangers when we're second-years, okay?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Okay! See you two!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Where are Rui and the others...? Oh, there they are, in front of the gate!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: I think we're last. Let's hurry up.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh... Okay!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (The breeze...and the smell of the leaves...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (The seasons keep on changing...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm going into a new school year with all sorts of challenges...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (But I'll be okay. I'm surrounded by my friends.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (Friends who chase dreams with me. And—)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, An!
You coming or what?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And friends here at school.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (I'm gonna keep them close...)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: (And never stop pursuing my goals.)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Coming!
